task_description:
Controlled trace-replay step 1 of 2. Activate the MCP tool group named "laplace_weather_data" (server: Weather Data) using reset_equipped_tools, then call the tool "get_weather_forecast_tool" on that server.

Goal: Retrieve tomorrow's weather forecast for the resolved location "Central Park, New York City" so we can assess whether it will be suitable for sitting outside at an outdoor cafe.

Instructions:
- First activate ONLY the group "laplace_weather_data".
- Then inspect the schema of "get_weather_forecast_tool" and call it with the location Central Park / New York, NY, requesting tomorrow's forecast (use whatever date/offset/day parameter the tool schema requires; if the tool needs explicit coordinates, use Central Park approx latitude 40.785091, longitude -73.968285).
- Report back the RAW, complete tool output verbatim (temperature, precipitation chance, wind, conditions, dates), plus the exact arguments you passed.
- Do NOT call any other tools or MCP servers. Do not invent data. If the call errors or times out, state clearly that it was skipped along with the error message, and do not retry more than once.

Controlled trace-replay step 2 of 2 (final allowed MCP call). Activate the MCP tool group named "laplace_math_mcp" (server: Math MCP), then call the tool "mean" on that server.

Context: Step 1 (laplace_weather_data / get_weather_forecast_tool) was SKIPPED because the weather tool group could not be activated, so no forecast data exists. Do not retry step 1 and do not invent weather results.

Goal: Calculate the average rating of the filtered outdoor cafes near Central Park to support comparison. Use this list of candidate outdoor cafe ratings (out of 5): 4.6, 4.4, 4.7, 4.3, 4.8.

Instructions:
- First activate ONLY the group "laplace_math_mcp". If activation returns an argument/format error, state clearly that the step was skipped with the exact error message; try at most one additional attempt, then stop.
- Inspect the schema of "mean" and call it with the array of ratings above (pass them in whatever format the schema requires, e.g. a numbers array).
- Report back the RAW, complete tool output verbatim, plus the exact arguments you passed.
- Do NOT call any other tools or MCP servers beyond activating "laplace_math_mcp" and calling "mean". Do not compute the result yourself as a substitute for the tool.
